name: Soyuz T-8
about: Soyuz T-8 (1983-035A), a crewed vehicle (7K-ST), launched 1983 Apr 20. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1983 Apr 21), held fixed
